_note: Settled-water rules (Steve, river settle). feeders: a painted river head that no pond spring serves gets its own spring, sized from the drainage area the tile file stores (flow map): share of the base spring = (area km2 / full_km2) ^ p, between min_share and 1, i.e. Q = k * A^p with k = rate / full_km2^p. A head is a river or pond cell with no higher water cell around it (a pond only when a painted river runs out of it within outlet_cells; a pond with no outlet is a natural pond and stays unfed); one with a spring within near_cells (30 cells = 240 m) is served. stop: the settle runs in blocks and stops once, in a block of check_every ticks, the stored water changed by under volume_change (5 percent) of what the springs poured in (basins full and spilling) twice running, after min_ticks, or at max_ticks. film (v8: ON, a look setting, Sonny and Dave 24 Oct 2026: a painted river that settles to a film under the 12 cm draw line read as dry): painted river cells with at least min_km2 of drainage and settled water between min_seen_m and depth_m are raised to depth_m so a thin river is drawn. springs_at_heads (Dave 24 Oct 2026: water sources start in a natural catch basin): a river head keeps its spring on the head (no plateau move) and a feeder on a river cell that is not a head within 10 cells snaps to the nearest head within snap_cells or is dropped. catchment (v6, Sonny and Dave 24 Oct 2026): a spring pours m3s_per_km2 x the catchment above its head (km2, from the tile's flow map), between min_m3s and max_m3s, at the x1 flow key; the game's flow key (x10 start) multiplies it. Without it every head poured a flat 10 m3/s x10 = 100 m3/s. steep: a spring on ground steeper than 25 degrees moves up the painted river to ground that is not steep, or is dropped. hollow_springs (v7, Sonny 24 Oct 2026): a hollow or carved bowl of min_depth_m and min_area_m2 or more with no spring gets an inflow at its deepest cell, the catchment flow of the biggest drainage on its cells. v9: catchment 1.0 m3/s per km2 (0.05-10), the v6 value 0.1 starved the rivers (tile 3,4 settle supplied 0.1M m3 instead of 5M and the painted channels drained to the sea); edge_inflows: a painted river entering over the tile edge gets a spring on the edge cell. version: bump when the rules change; settle_water prints it.
